title: ProtoCellLayout: Prototype-Guided Graph Learning for Accurate and Generalizable Standard Cell Layout PPA Estimation
problem: Standard cell layout PPA estimation requires rapid and precise methods; geometry-based approaches lack accuracy, SPICE simulations are slow, and ML methods don't capture layout-dependent effects and require massive training data.
motivation: Accelerate Design Technology Co-Optimization (DTCO) for advanced semiconductor process nodes.
method: Topology-Geometry Graph (TGG) representation integrating circuit topology and geometric features; prototype learning mechanism leveraging CMOS logic structural regularity and routing pattern similarity for generalization across cells with minimal training data.
key_novelty: TGG representation capturing both topology and geometry; prototype learning for cross-cell generalization using structural regularity.
contributions: Topology-Geometry Graph (TGG) representation method integrating circuit and geometric features
Prototype learning mechanism exploiting CMOS structural regularity
Accurate PPA estimation from layout without excessive training data

metrics.ppa: <3.5% percentage error, >95% accuracy in layout selection

limitations: Evaluated only on industrial standard cell library; generalization to custom cells or different technologies unclear.
primary_theme: Graph learning for cell layout PPA
